༄// rgyal bas dri med lung gis bsngags pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab glegs bam bzhi pa las dpal kun rig gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs sgrib pa rnam sel bzhugs so// dpal kun rig gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs sgrib pa rnam sel zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings mkha' la rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// phrin las zer gyis 'gro la phan mdzad pa// bcom ldan thams cad rig la gus btud nas// bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i cho ga bshad kyis nyon// 'dir kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnas dben par lha bcu gnyis bkod pa'i ras bris sam/ lugs sku la sogs pa'i mdun du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po bsham/ rang gi mdun du dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu yang bzhag la/ khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug nas/ thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du bya ba'i tshul gyis/ rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya ba la gnyis te/ mnyam gzhag dang*/ rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis kyi dang po srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ thog mar bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus byas nas/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed de/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shu d+dhonya haṃ gis chos bdag med pa bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu 'gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon zhi ba'i nyams can/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ de'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ rgyu ma dang mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu byas pa gnas gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na lārka ma hā badz+ra kro dha dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba/ bi dra ba/ sarba a pa ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra/ prā ṇāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis bdag bsrung*/ yang lan gsum brjod la/ dang pos 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ gnyis pas phyogs rdo rje'i rwa ba me dang bcas pa/ gsum pas de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur bsams la/ gnas bsrung*/ yang lan gsum brjod pas rnal 'byor bsrung bar bsams te/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o// spro na rdo rje 'byung ba ltar rgyas pa bsgoms te logs su bkod zin to// 'di ni bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsag nas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul rnams rnal 'byor pas stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas na/ lam gyi dang po bdud kyi las spong ba dang*/ dge ba chung ngu nas bsgrub pa tshogs kyi lam mo// gnyis pa rnal 'byor dngos la/

dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang a bsam/ thal mo gnyis la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ā+ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥrnams kyis gang ba las 'od zer 'phro ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐/ gung mo la trāṃ/ srin lag la hrīḥ mthe'u chung la aḥbakod de/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin 'byung*/ srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun ma rnams pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs zhal phyag rigs lnga dang 'dra bar bsams pa ni sbyor lam drod do// de nas lag pa mnyam pa'i thal mo dang*/ oṃ an+yo3n+ya/ a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmāḥ lha dang lha mo rnams reg par bsams pa ni rtse mo'o// rdo rje thal mo dang*/ s+pha ra s+pha ra/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥbadz+ra añja lis rjes su chags par bsams pa ni bzod pa'o// rdo rje bsdam pa dang*/ a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra bhan+dhas ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams pa ni chos mchog ste/ 'chad byed cha mthun bzhi nyams su len pa'i man ngag go /de nas rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya lan gsum dkrol zhing*/ badz+ra ban+dha traṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad bral bar bsams pa ni mthong lam skye ba'i sngon du gegs bsal ba'o// rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha zhes dang*/ a bcu nas brgya'i bar du bzlas nas/ snying gar dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin babs par bsams pa ni mthong lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i man ngag go /de nas sngar gyi phyag rgya de bca' zhing*/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da yaṃ me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes brjod cing phyag rgya bkrol/ yang phyag rgya de nyid bca' zhing*/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ gyis phyag rgya bkrol zhing se gol gtogs te/ ye shes babs pa rnams brtan par bsams pa ni/ sgom lam sa dgur chos nyid kyi rtogs pa goms par byed pa'o// de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu 'gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu kha dkur brten pa sems pa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams te/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sku dang*/ thal mo snyim pa sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gsung dang*/ rdo rje thal mo las gung mo gnyis dang mtha' bzhi sbyar te brkyang pa snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis thugs byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa nyid nges don du chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o// de nas rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang pa phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/

oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor mnyam la lhag ma thams cad brkyang pa/ sdig pa bsreg pa'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod cing gnas de rnams su mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par bsams te/ sangs rgyas gong ma rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'o// de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ spyir sems can thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu ngan song gsum dang*/ khyad par du tshe 'das sogs dmigs yul gang yin pa la phogs pas 'gro ba de dag gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsams la/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od zer 'phro ba dang bsdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun du snang bar byas so// kun du snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun du snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas mgo bos lan brgya stong phrag du mar phyag 'tshal te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to// o ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod// ces ched du brjod par bsams te/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas spyir sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ de ltar ston pa nges don du sangs rgyas nas slar yang zhing 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas/ gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba dang mthun par sku sna tshogs kyis sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa ltar nyams su len pa ste/ de yang bdag nyid nam mkhar gnas pas/ oṃ sha zhes sam/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ bha yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba la steng nas drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing*/ mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang*/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol du khyams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug sngon po/ phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'od zer phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o// de'i nang du rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba le tshe dgu pa'i phyogs bzhi nas ka ba gnyis gnyis te ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang*/ de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pas mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ khang bzangs gnyis ka'i nang gi gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i/ lhor rta'i/ nub tu rma bya'i/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang*/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyi sgo'i khro bo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan bsams pa ni/ ma dag pa'i gnas rdo rje'i gdan du byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas rang nyid phyag rgya chen po 'og min nas babs te dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khod par bsam/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mtha' skor du/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil ba ltar bkod pa'i nang du/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bsam/ de gnyis las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ 'od zer des sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don mdzad/ tshur 'dus dbus kyi snying po la thim pas bdag nyid gtso bo'i skur gyur te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ rtsa zhal shar du gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'am/ yang na gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid bskyed sngags rtsa rig dang bcas par 'gyur/

de las 'od zer spros bsdus yongs su gyur pa las kun rig tu bsams pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa slar yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ston pa'o// de nas 'khor rnams thugs ka nas spro zhing rang gnas su 'god de/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du/ oṃ sogs rtsa ba'i rig pa/ de'i nang du/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes pa bsams pa ni snying po bskyed pa'i sgo'o// de gnyis las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas pa ni 'od zer spro ba'i sgo'o// 'od zer des sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don mdzad par bsams pa ni mdzad pa mdzad pa'i sgo'o// 'od zer slar 'dus sngar gyi chos kyi yi ge la thim pa ni 'od zer bsdu ba'i sgo'o// sngags dang 'od zer dbyer med du 'dres pa las sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can du gyur pa ni lha bskyed pa'i sgo'o// de nyid thugs ka nas phyung nas shar gyi re mig gi gdan la 'khod par bsams pa ni rang gnas su 'god pa'i sgo ste/ 'og ma thams cad kyang de ltar sgo drug las bskyed par bya'o// de bzhin du oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ rgyal mchog rin chen sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can lhor dgod/ oṃ sarba bid āḥshākya rigs dbang ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can nub tu dgod/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ me tog cher rgyas ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa byang gi rwa mig gi gdan la dgod/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can du bsams pa ni/ sangs rgyas nas de bzhin gshegs pas 'dul ba la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mtha' skor du oṃ sogs rtsa rig gis bskor ba/

de'i dbus su/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ de gnyis las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus chos kyi yi ge la thim/ sngags dang 'od zer dbyer med du 'dres pa las spyan ma dkar mo/ g.yas pa spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin par gyur/ thugs ka nas phyir spros shar lho'i gdan la 'khod par bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī trāṃ/ mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa lho nub tu 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa re de hi de hi sid+dhi bo dhi lo ki tā rāṃ ba swā hā/ gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa nub byang du 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa swā hā/ sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa byang shar du 'khod/ bzhi ka'ang g.yon gdan la brten cing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing nu 'bur zung gis mdzes par bsams pa ni lha mos 'dul ba la de'i rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// de bzhin du gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du/ oṃ sogs rtsa rig dbus su hūm̐ dkar po de nyid las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus chos kyi yi ge la thim/ sngags dang 'od zer dbyer med du 'dres pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ thugs ka nas phyir spros/ shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po la 'khod/ dza rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa rtsibs gnyis par/ ho rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa rtsibs gsum par/ dhu rdo rje legs pa ljang gu rdo rje se gol gyis legs so ster ba rtsibs bzhi par 'khod/ trāṃ rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing g.yon dril bu dkur 'dzin pa lho'i rtsibs dang por 'khod/ r+ya rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa gnyis par/

bh+ri rdo rje rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa gsum par/ ha rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i phreng ba 'dzin pa rtsibs bzhi par 'khod/ hrīḥrdo rje chos dkar la cung zad dmar ba g.yon pad+ma 'dzin cing g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa nub kyi rtsibs dang por 'khod/ dhīḥrdo rje rnon po sngon po g.yas ral gri g.yon posti 'dzin pa gnyis par/ kruṃ rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor zhing 'dzin pa gsum par/ bha rdo rje smra ba dmar ser rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa bzhi par 'khod/ kaṃ rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa byang gi rtsibs dang por 'god/ raṃ rdo rje srung ba ser po rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa gnyis par/ k+ṣaṃ rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar mche ba 'dzin pa gsum par/ saṃ rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis 'dzin pa bzhi par 'khod/ hūm̐ sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa nang gi grwa bzhi'i shar lhor 'khod/ trāṃ phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa lho nub tu/ hrīḥglu ma dkar dmar pi wang 'dzin pa nub byang du/ aḥgar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pas gar byed pa byang shar du 'khod/ hūm̐ bdug spos ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa phyi'i grwa bzhi'i shar lhor 'khod/ trāṃ me tog ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa lho nub tu/ hrīḥmar me dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa nub byang du/ aḥdri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa byang shar du 'khod/ dzaḥrdo rje lcags kyu dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa shar sgor 'khod/ hūm̐ rdo rje zhags pa ser po zhags pa 'dzin pa lho sgor/

baṃ rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa nub sgor/ hoḥrdo rje dril bu ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa byang sgor 'khod par bsams pa ni/ lha de dang des 'dul ba'i sems can gyi don du so so'i rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can zhi ba'i nyams can pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du/ oṃ sogs rtsa rig dbus su rtsa rig tshar bzhi sngon po/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus chos kyi yi ge rnams la thim/ sngags dang 'od zer dbyer med du 'dres pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par 'gyur/ thugs ka nas phyir spros/ sgo phyi ma'i lha snam dang po'i shar phyogs kyi gdan rnams la 'khod par bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ na mo sogs dang*/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi ser po lho'i gdan rnams la 'khod/ rtsa rig dang 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ drwa ba can gyi 'od bzhi dmar po nub kyi gdan rnams la/ rtsa rig dang*/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi ljang gu byang gi gdan rnams la 'khod/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs kar dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams te/ byang sems kyis 'dul ba la de'i rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// oṃ sogs rtsa rig bcu drug dang*/

'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ maud gal gyi bu dang*/ rab 'byor/ 'char ka ma 'gags pa/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang*/ nye bar 'khor rta thul/ ba lang bdag kun dga' bo dang*/ ming chen/ nor sbyin 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung rnams spros/ lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir rang rang gi gdan la 'khod/ nyan thos bcu drug po thams cad kyang lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams te/ nyan thos kyis 'dul ba la de'i rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// rtsa rig bcu gnyis dang*/ gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ 'jigs pa med pa/ dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ ri bo rgyal ba/ smra ba'i sgra chen/ bse ru lta bu/ dug chen 'joms/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston/ seng ge sgra/ yid myur rnams spros/ snam bu gnyis pa'i mtshams bzhi dang phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bcu gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khod/ de thams cad kyang dbu'i gtsug tor phyed dang bcas shing drang srong gi cha lugs can 'khar gsil dang posti 'dzin pa/ chos gos bsnams shing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams te/ rang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba la de'i rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// rtsa rig bcu drug dang*/ shar du khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyis lcags kyu ma/ lhor 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub tu 'jig rten gsum 'ching*/ g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang du 'jig rten gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma rnams spros/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i sgo bzhir rang rang gi gdan la 'khod/

de thams cad kyang sku mdog ma nges pa dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsams te/ khro bo dang*/ bran dang*/ pho nya dang*/ mngags pas 'dul ba'i sems can la de dang de dag gi rnam pas don mdzad pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du oṃ sogs rtsa rig gis bskor ba/ de'i dbus su rtsa ba'i rig pa kha dog sna tshogs pa tshar bcu/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus chos kyi yi ge la thim/ sngags dang 'od zer dbyer med du 'dres pa las/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ thugs ka nas phyir spros/ phyi'i khor yug gi gdan rnams kyi steng du tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen brgyad/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs pa'i klu chen brgyad/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' chen brgyad/ snar ma dang smin drug la sogs pa'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po la sogs pa'i rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ ma hā bhai ra wa la sogs pa'i 'jigs byed chen po dgu ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun bcu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gang ba bzang po dang nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ laṅka mgrin bcu la sogs pa srin po'i tshogs dang*/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa bud med kyi tshogs dang*/ tsartsi kā la sogs pa phra men ma'i tshogs dang*/ wā rā hī la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang ri'i lha dang*/ shing gi lha dang*/ grong gi lha dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang ldan zhing*/ so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur ces bsams te/

sangs rgyas nyid 'jig rten pa 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la tshangs pa la sogs pa de dang de'i rnam par sprul nas gdul bya so so'i don mdzad pa'o// gsum pa las rgyal mchog ni/ de ltar dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor spros nas bkod pa la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i phyir du/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje se gol gyi sgras 'og min na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mi g.yo ba'i bsam gtan las bslang bar bsam/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbha ga wān e h+ye hi/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hās mchod yon dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐ gis dri dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ gis me tog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra d+dhu pe hūm̐ gis spos dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ye hūm̐ gis bshos dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐ gis mar me rnams phul la/ rdo rje thal mo dpral bar sbyar nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta pra ṇa mya na badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag byas par mos la/ sgo ba bzhi'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nam mkha'i lha bdag bskyed kyi lha so so dang nye bar dgug oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ gis rang rang la gzhug oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ gyis phan tshun mi 'bral bar bcing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ lha rnams dbyer med du dbang du byas par bsams pa ni ye shes pa gzhug pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku rnams sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i bzhed pa dang ldan pa'o// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir sngar gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba'i skabs su lag pa byin gyis brlabs pa de dran par byas la/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs rigs gsum gyi sngags rgyas bdag bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab bo// de nas phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab pa la/

gzhan phan 'od zer du mdun bskyed kyi lha sgrub pa'i skabs su kha 'phangs shing*/ der rgyas 'debs dang*/ las sbyar cig car du byed pa'i tshul dang rgyas 'debs bzhi rkyang par byed pa'i tshul gnyis ka bshad pa las/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'dir las sbyar byed pa'i dmigs gsal ma gsungs pas rgyas 'debs rkyang pa nyams su blang par bya'o// de la dang po dam rgya ni lus kyi bca' ba lag pa gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ sems kyis gtso bo'i thugs kar sems dpa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig gis rgyas btab par bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ sarba bita hūm̐ sogs lan gsum gsum gyis rigs bzhi dang yum bzhi'i sngags sngar bskyed chog tu bshad pa ltar/ lan gsum gsum gyis mtshams ma bzhi dang*/ de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu dhu/ zhes pa shar sems bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra te dzar+ya/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu bh+ri/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha ste lho sems bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa dhīḥ oṃ badz+ra he tu kruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa bha ste nub sems bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra karmā kaṃ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa k+ṣaṃ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi saṃ ste byang phyogs pa bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥste nang gi lha mo bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhup+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥste phyi'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥste sgo ba bzhi rnams kyi sngags lan gsum gsum brjod/ rang rang gi dam rgya snying gar bca'/ de nas sgo phyi ma'i lha rnams la rang rang gi dam rgya bca' zhing*/

sems dpa' bcu drug la rtsa rig lan gsum/ nyan thos bcu drug la gsum/ rang rgyal bcu gnyis la gsum/ khro bo bcu drug la gsum brjod cing so so'i dam rgya bca'/ de nas phyi'i khor yug la gnas pa rnams la/ dbang phyug chen po sogs kyi lha rnams la rtsa rig lan gsum/ klu rnams la gsum/ gnod sbyin rnams la gsum/ srin po rnams la gsum/ bud med rnams la gsum/ gza' rnams la gsum/ rgyu skar rnams la gsum/ phra men ma rnams la gsum/ rnal 'byor ma rnams la gsum/ phyogs skyong sogs lha lhag ma rnams la rtsa rig gsum dang rang rang gi spyi'i phyag rgya rnams bca'/ lha thams cad kyi thug kar sems dpa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re'i rgyas gdab par bsams pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o// de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yon pa pang du gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng du g.yas bzhag ste mthe bong gnyis ngos sprad pa ni gtso bo'i dam rgya'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi sbyar la bsgreng*/ mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni ngan song sbyong ba'i'o// phyag rgya gong ma de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal mchog gi'o// mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor sbyar la/ lhag ma 'bar ba ltar byas pa ni shāka thub kyi'o// de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba ni me tog cher rgyas kyi'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i logs la mig 'dra bar sbyar ba srin lag dang*/ mthe'u chung nang du bcug pa'i steng mthe bos mnan pa ni spyan ma'i'o// thal mo sbyar ba las srin lag dang mthe'u chung nang du bcug mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rwa ltar gung mo la ma reg par lta ba ni mā ma kī'i'o// thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis pad+ma ltar byas la mthe'u chung gnyis so sor phral ba ni gos dkar mo'i'o// thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas dkris/

mthe bong gung mo la sbyar lhag ma bsnol ba ni sgrol ma'i'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i'o// de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas bkug pa ni rdo rje rgyal po'i'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis mda' 'dra bar sbyar ba ni chags pa'i'o// de nyid slar bkug ste mthe bong gnyis la sbyar nas se gol gtogs pa ni legs pa'i'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar te tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni rin chen gyi'o// de nyid las sor mo lhag ma rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o// de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi'o// de nyid kha'i thad kar bskor te bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje chos kyi'o// de nyid las rtse mo cung zad bkug pa ni rnon po'i'o// de nyid gdu bu 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje'i rgyu'o// de nyid las rtse mo pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar byas nas cung zad kha phye ba ni smra ba'i'o// de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bskyed pa ni las kyi'o// de nyid las shin tu bskyed pa ni srung ba'i'o// de nyid las rtse mo gnyis slar bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o// de nyid mdun du bkug la bsdams pa ni khu tshur gyi'o// rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag pa ni sgeg mo'i'o// de nyid dpral bar brkyang ba ni phreng ba ma'i'o// rdo rje thal mo kha nas dbyung ba ni glu ma'i'o// de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa ni gar ma'i'o// rdo rje bsdams pa mdun du bzhag pa ni bdug pa ma'i'o// de nyid las gyen du 'thor ba ni me tog ma'i'o// mdun du mthe bong gnyis mnyam ste bskor ba ni mar me ma'i'o// de nyid dbyug pa ltar byas pa ni dri'i'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i'o// de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sbyar ba ni zhags pa'i'o// de nyid gcig la gcig mdud pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o// de nyid las mthe bong nang du bcug ste bskyod pa ni dril bu'i dam rgya ste/

rgyud 'dir dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya'ang de nyid do// thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo dang srin lag sbyar mthe'u chung nang du bcug mthe bong gnyis kyi rtser mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste sbyar ba ni byang sems spyi'i'o// thal mo snying gar sbyar ba ni nyan thos thams cad kyi'o// g.yon khu tshur nang du bstan te/ mtheb mdzub sbyar ba bsgreng*/ g.yas mtheb srin sbyar te/ lhag ma brkyang ba g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub kyi steng du bzhag pa ni rang rgyal rnams kyi'o// rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang brtse sprad tha ma bzhi so sor bsgreng ba ni 'jig rten gsum snang la sogs pa bcu drug gi'o// thal mo sbyar ba las dbus ma gsum bkug ste rtse sprad tha ma bzhi bskyed pa ni lha rnams kyi'o// thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gshibs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mos ma reg par bkug mthe bong gnyis gshibs la bsgreng lhag ma bsnol ba ni klu rnams kyi'o// lag pa gnyis mnyam du gshibs pa'i sen mo rnams so ltar gshibs la mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar cung zad brkyang ba ni gnod sbyin rnams kyi'o// g.yas pa'i snyim pa mgo tshal ltar ston pa ni srin po rnams kyi'o// sor mo bcu phan tshun bsnol ba ni bud med rnams kyi'o// g.yon khu tshur snying gar bsdu la g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa ltar mdzub mo bsgreng ba ni gza' rnams kyi'o// thal mo gnyis mdun du bkan pa'i gung mo gnyis bkug pa ni rgyu skar rnams kyi'o// lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo bcu'i rtse bkug ste sprad pa'i snyim pa ni phra men ma rnams kyi'o// de nyid las mthe bong gnyis nang du lce ltar byas pa ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi'o// thal mo sbyar ba brkyang la pad skor byas te thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba ni phyogs skyong sogs 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi dam rgya'o// de nas chos rgyal lus kyi rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung*/

lag pa mnyam gzhag sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod lam bya/ ngag sems gnyis kyis lha thams cad kyi mgrin par hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mdun gyi 'dab ma lcer gyur pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar so so'i sa bon bzhugs par bsams la/ rigs lnga la/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥdang*/ yum bzhi la yang*/ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥdang*/ sems dpa' bcu drug la/ hūm̐ dzaḥho dhu/ trāṃ r+ya bh+ri ha/ hrīḥdhīḥkruṃ bha/ kaṃ raṃ k+ṣaṃ saṃ dang*/ phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad la/ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī aḥ yang hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥdang*/ sgo ba bzhi la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdang*/ sgo phyi ma man chad kyi lha la/ sde tshan gyi grangs dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ dkar po re re bsam zhing brjod pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o// de nas las rgya'i phyir/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sprad pa dku g.yon du bzhag ngag tu/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig zlos/ ta t+ya thā'i tshe khu tshur bkrol la/ nu ma g.yas dang g.yon dang snying ga gsum du gar bskor bya zhing*/ swā hā'i bar brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas gong gi 'byin sngags lan re glur blang zhing*/ lha so so'i phyag chen dang 'jig rten pa rnams la dam rgya bcu po bca'/ phyag mtshan ni mi bsgom la/ sems kyis lha thams cad kyi thugs kar aḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje re re'i rgyas gdab par bsams pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o// de nas phyag chen gyi phyir rang rang gi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag chen ji ltar bzhugs pa bzhin bcings te/ phyag mtshan yod pa'i lha rnams la phyag mtshan dang bcas pa'i skur bsgom zhing*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la thal mo sbyar ba chos nyan pa'i phyag chen bcas la/ chos rgya'i skabs ltar snying po lan re brjod/ sems kyis lha thams cad kyi thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res rgyas gdab par bsams pa ni phyag rgya chen po ste/

de ltar phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa ni sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi sku gsung thugs phrin las dang bzhi las sems can gyi don byed pa'i nus pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i phyir/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shap+ta dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas// zhes sogs brjod pas bstod par bsams te/ sprul pa'i sku la tshangs pa la sogs pas 'khor lo rtsibs stong sogs kyi yon phul nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa'i tshul lam du byed pa'o// de nas bdag nyid dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal gyis lha'i rnam pa la sems yun ring du bzung ngo*// bsgoms pas skyo na/ ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du rtsa rig bkod la/ de las 'od 'phros ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shodha ne shodha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi shu dha ne/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shodha ne swā hā/ zhes pa lnga brgya la sogs pa bzla/ de'i tshe 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang sngags kyi sgra byung bar bsam/ de nas 'khor gyi lha rang rang gi thugs kar zla ba la rang rang gi sngags dang mtha' skor du rtsa rig bsams pa las sngar bzhin 'od zer gyi spro bsdu byas la/ oṃ sarba bita hūm̐/ zhes sogs/ so so'i sngags sum brgya tsam dang*/ bskal bzang nas 'jig rten pa'i bar gyi lha re re la rtsa rig nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas la/

mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems cad thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas bsgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsams te/ sprul pa'i skus gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par chos gsungs pas/ gdul bya de dag theg pa gsum gyi lam la bkod pa la sogs pas sems can gyi bsam pa tshim par mdzad pa'o// slar yang bdag nyid dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa la mchod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas thal mo sbyar la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams go brjes la/ me tog dang puṣ+pa/ bdug spos dang dhū pe/ snang gsal dang a lo ke dri mchog dang gan+dhe/ zhal bzas dang nai wi t+ye/ rol mo dang shap+ta rnams kyis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tswa li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas rol mo ci 'byor pa 'bul/ spro na lha mo brgyad kyis mchod do// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa// rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje sku ste sku che ba// phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba// rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba// rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che// phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po// rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa// rdo rje rnon po rno ba che// che ba'i che ba rgya mtsho che// rdo rje pad+ma byang chub che// byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba// rdo rje rgya chen rgya chen te// rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che// rdo rje pad+mo rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che// rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso// rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba che// rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed// rdo rje ro langs ro langs che// rdo rje srin po za ba po// rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che// rdo rje gdon te gdon gyi mchog

/'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che// rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa// bsgrub dka'i bsgrub pa legs pa ste// rdo rje legs pa dgyed mdzad pa// rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che// dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa// 'od stug pas ni stug pa che// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po// re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho// rdo rje ye shes ye shes che// rig sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// ha la ha la nag po che// dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa can// rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che// snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba// skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod// glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro// rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul// drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa// nyi ma stong gis gdungs pa'i zhal// spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po// khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro// phyag rnams du mar mtshon cha brgya// du ma'i zhal te sku yang ston// 'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyil ba ste// sems kyi chos las sku mi mnga'// rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul// ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste// 'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar mdzad// sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can// rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba// zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs pa// sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku// rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems// kun tu bzang po cher bzang po// mtshan rnams dam pas rab brgyan pa// khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang*// zhes pas bstod do// chos kyis tshim pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis rang rang gi ston pa la bsnyen bkur dang yon tan brjod pa sogs kyis mnyes par byas pa'o// de nas yi ge brgya pa brjod cing lhag chad kha bskang*/

nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ gtso bo'i dam rgya dang*/ rtsa rig lan gsum brjod pas phyag rgya rnams bkrol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rnams rang la bsdus te/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la sems yun ring du mnyam par gzhag pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku rnams gdul bya so so'i don mdzad zin te so so'i zhing khams su gshegs pa dang*/ rgyal bas zhing 'di'i mdzad pa mthar phyin nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'o// gnyis pa rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor ni/ slar yang byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha'i nga rgyal du langs la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyi ched du bsngo/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du mdo bklags pa/ gtor ma sbyin pa/ tsha tsha gdab pa/ chos bshad nyan byed pa sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba lam du byed pa ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lha'i rnal 'byor mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang por tshogs bsags pa nas brtsams te/ mthar yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i bar dang*/ slar yang mdzad pa rgyun mi chad par sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul dang bstun nas nyams su len pa 'di ni thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs su shes par bya'o// gang gi tshe thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor du byed pa de'i tshe/ thun dang po la sngar bzhin bstod pa yan chad byas la/ rang mar me gcig las gnyis chad pa ltar/ gtso bo las bye nas bsgoms pa'i lha nang du bzhugs par bsams te/

khang pa'i phyi rol du spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// de nas thun gnyis pa dang gsum pa la rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas khang pa'i nang du zhugs la/ sngar bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bdag nyid tha mi dad du bsgoms nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yud tsam gyis dran par byas la mchod pa nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar bya'o// thun tha ma la yi ge brgya pas bsgom bzlas kyi nus pa brtan par bya ba nas brtsams te/ thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i bar sngar ltar bya'o// de ltar na rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal bstan pa dang*/ chos gsungs pa sogs dang ras bris kyi lha bzhad pa dang*/ 'od 'bar ba la sogs pa byung gi bar dang*/ 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug du bsgom bzlas kyis dus 'da' bar bya ba dang*/ tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa rtsa rig 'bum phrag gsum mam drug thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du bzlas te/ bsnyen pa las su rung bar gyur na gnas skabs su las kyi sgrib pa ci bsags pa thams cad byang ba dang*/ mthar thug khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar mdzad pa yi// rang don brnyes dang gzhan don bsgrub pa'i tshul// rjes 'jug skye bos nyams su len pa'i thabs// zab pa'i tshul 'di rnal 'byor rgyud du bshad// 'di don tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i thabs// rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin legs bkod pa// 'di yi dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gyur cig /dpal kun rig gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i tshul gsal bar ston pa 'di ni/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bsnyengs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can/ rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/

shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer gyi dgongs pa ci lta ba bzhin du rnga chen gyi lo// sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni yo ga pa chos skyong bzang pos bgyis so// //shu bhaṃ// //

༄༅// dpal kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal kun rig gi ras ris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// mtha' yas shes bya'i chos kun ma lus mkhyen// nang gi chos sku ye shes mig gis rig /dmigs med snying rjes ngan song 'gro ba 'dren// thub pa skyes mchog rnam snang che la 'dud// de yi go 'phang 'thob byed cho ga'i rim// rgyud dang sngon rabs mkhas pa'i gzhung mang dang*// khyad par rje btsun mchog gi dgongs pa ltar// 'khrul med go bde'i ngag gis bshad kyis nyon// 'dir kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dpon slob rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i rim pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ las kyi rdo rjes/ lha khang la sogs pa'i dbus su sa gzhi la gad bdar bya shing dri bzang po'i chus byugs/ me tog sil mar gtor/ der ras dang dar la sogs pa gzhi bzang po'i steng du kun rig gi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor rab gnas can mdun shar du phyogs par bkod/ de'i mthar g.yas skor du mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ 'byor na lha re re zhing mchod pa ci nus pa bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs su phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma dang*/ rigs drug dang yi dwags la sil gtor gnyis dang*/ bgegs gtor te lnga bsham/ mchod pa'i bum pa brgyad dam bcu drug 'bru dang*/ sman dang*/ dri chab kyis bkang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pas mtha' bskor/ mchod bum ma 'byor na 'khar phor la sogs pa la tshab bya bar bshad/ gzhan yang bla bre dang*/ 'phan dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs pas brgyan no// de'i mtha' skor du sgrub pa po rnams kyi gdan dang rdo rje dril bu bsham/

slob dpon gyi mdun du rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma bris pa nang rdzas dang chus gang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pa bsham/ 'byor na dbang gi bum pa lnga bkod/ bla ma phyi ma rnams yo ga gzhan ltar las bum mdzad kyang rje btsun gyis ma gsungs pas mi dgos so// gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor/ bum pa bzlas pa/ mdun bskyed mchod pa'o// dang po la gnyis las/ dang po srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ sgrub pa po rnams/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du zhugs/ stan rnams la 'dug nas/ thog mar mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ dang*/ de'i phyag rgyas bgegs bsal/ rdo rje me'i sngags rgyas gzi byin bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsams la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya zhing*/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod do// de nas bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus byas nas/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed de/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis chos bdag med par bsgom/

stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lce'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nyal thabs su gnas par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwā/ zhes pas lce rdo rjer byin gyis brlab/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re/ de zhu ba lag pa la thim pas lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur par bsam/ de nas hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon khu tshur gyis dril bu snyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa cung zad khro ba sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ gṛh+na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ bam̐ dang*/ ti rīn+ti ri'i phyag rgyas nga rgyal gzung*/ phyag rgya de nyid spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ba g.yas pa/ ltag pa/ rna ba g.yon pa rnams su bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ gyis gnas de lngar rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re bsams la dbang blangs/ oṃ ṭuṃ dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdud pa 'ching bzhin pa'i tshul du byas la/ snying ga mgrin pa ltag pa dang*// snying ga nu ma'i bar dang ni// snying ga mgrin pa rgyab dpral ba// zhes pa'i gnas rnams su reg la/ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang ba/ dkyus su khru nyi shu rtsa gcig pas gnas dgur mdud pa bya zhing*/ dpral bar thal mo rtse sprad nas gsham brdab ste/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes pas rna ba gnyis kyi steng du dar dpyangs kyi 'gugs phyung nas lhag ma lus dang mnyam par bsams te/ bdag nyid rigs kyi khro bor bskyed pa'o// de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ gis bgegs la bsnun/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsreg

oṃ badz+ra ne tri bhan+dha sarba bighāṃ gyis bgegs bcing ste sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga'o// de nas oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa ban+dha rak+ṣa sarbān swā hās 'og bcing*/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis steng bcing*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis sngar gyi 'og bcing*/ oṃ druṃ ban+dha haṃ gis shar bcing*/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pā sha hrīḥzhes pas shar gyi nang bcing*/ oṃ pa taṅki pa taṅki ni ra ṭas nub bcing*/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭas byang bcing*/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa ma ṭas lho bcing*/ hūm̐ badz+ra karmās dkyil 'khor bcing*/ hūm̐ zhes pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi rwa ba bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ gyis thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom mo// de dag gi phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa nang bcings byas la mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba khros pa'i tshul gyis steng nas bkab pa ni khro bo ti rīn+ti ri'i phyag rgya'o// g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul du bya ba ni bgegs la bsnun pa'i phyag rgya'o// rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la kha gyen du bstan pa phye ste/ sor mo rnams nang du bsnol ba 'bar ba ltar byas la/ mthe bong gnyis srin lag dang gung mo'i bar nas bsgreng nas rtse mo sbyar ba ni rdo rje me'i phyag rgya ste bgegs bsreg pa'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong gnyis brkyang ste gshibs pa ni rdo rje spyan gyi phyag rgya ste bgegs bcing ba'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa brkyang ba sa la bzhag pa ni 'og bcing ba'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin bskor te mgo bo'i steng du mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bzhag pa ni rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan gyi phyag rgya ste steng bcing ba'i 'o// rdo rje thal mo las mthe bong gnyis brkyangs la mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar byas pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi rgya ste steng gi 'og bcing pa'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel la mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar te bzlog nas spyi bor bzhag pa ni rdo rje gtsug tor gyi rgya ste shar bcing ba'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gcig la gcig gis mkhrig ma'i gnas kyi cha mdud par byas te zhags mig gi tshul du byas pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'i rgya ste shar gyi nang bcing ba'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las/

mthe bong g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag la mdzub mo gnyis mnyam par gshibs te cung zad phye la mthe'u chung gnyis bsgreng ba ni rdo rje ba dan gyi rgya ste nub bcing ba'i 'o// sngar gyi rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya khar bzhag pa ni rdo rje dus kyi rgya ste byang bcing ba'i 'o// sngags rgya 'di nyid kyis phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og gi bgegs rnams tshar bcad par bsam mo// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul ltar bya ba ni rdo rje rtse mo'i rgya ste lho bcing ba'i 'o// hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba ni rdo rje las kyi rgya ste dkyil 'khor bcing ba'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcing nas g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma'i rgyab kyi steng du g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma'i rgyab bzhag nas bsnol ba'i mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel la mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba ni hūm̐ mdzad kyi rgya ste de nyid kyi rwa ba'o// rdo rje bsdams pa ni/ thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa'i phyag rgya ste sngar gyi sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum gsum bya ba ni srung ba'i 'khor lo'o// de nas spro na/ rang me ltar 'bar ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas khro bo'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren gdul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/

puṣ+pe/ d+dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi t+ye/ shap+ta hūm̐ gis mchod/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spang zhing*// thabs la mkhas pa'i 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen brtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos sgrub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod do// dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// zhes pas bgegs la bka' bsgo/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/

dpral bar/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ lkog mar/ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐/ spyi bor/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la bdag bsrung*/ sngags dang phyag rgya de nyid kyis shar nas bzung nas phyogs bzhi dang*/ me nas bzung ste mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du byas pas gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrungs te bgegs med par byas/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ rdo rje srung ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi baṃ rnams kyis bdag brtan par bsrung*/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung rtse sprad de skyed pa ni las kyi'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste rtse sprad pa ni srung ba'i 'o// de nyid las mthe bong gnyis bsnol te bzhag pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug pa'i rgyab mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan pa ni khu tshur gyi'o// de nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsi taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ri' bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes pa lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// 'di rnams ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon cung zad kyang med do// //gnyis pa bdag bskyed dngos la gsum/ lha sgrub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang aḥbasam/

thal mo gnyis la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥrnams kyis gang ba las 'od zer 'phro ba g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐/ gung mo la trāṃ/ srin lag la hrīḥ mthe'u chung la aḥbakod de/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin chen 'byung*/ srin lag 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun ma rnams pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs zhal phyag rigs lnga dang 'dra bar bsams la/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang*/ oṃ a n+yo3n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmāḥs lha dang lha mo rnams reg rdo rje thal mo dang*/ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra añja li rjes su zhugs/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang*/ a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra ban+dhas gcig tu 'dres par bsam zhing sems 'od gsal bar bsams la/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya lan gsum dgrol zhing*/ badz+ra ban+dha tra ṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad dral/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha zhes dang*/ aḥbacu nas brgya'i bar bzlas nas/ snying gar dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin du dbab cing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to ma bha wa hṛ da ya m+me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥzhes brjod cing phyag rgya dgrol/ yang phyag rgya de nyid bca' zhing*/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ gyis phyag rgya dgrol zhing se gol gtogs te ye shes pa rnams brtan par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar btod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu kha dkur bstan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams te/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sku dang*/ thal mo snyim par sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gsung dang*/ rdo rje thal mo las gung mo gnyis dang mtha' bzhi sbyar te brkyang ba'am/ bla ma phyi ma rnams rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi sbyar bar bzhed de phyag rgya de snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis thugs byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang ba phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ de nyid las/ mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas la dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor mnyam la/ lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba sdig pa sreg pa'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya rna ltag pa g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod cing*/ gnas de rnams su mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par bsam mo// de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas/

spyir sems can thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu ngan song gsum dang*/ khyad par du tshe 'das sogs dmigs yul gang yin pa la phog pas/ 'gro ba de dag gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsams la/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang sdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so// kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas mgo bos lan brgya stong phrag du mar phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to// e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod// ces ched du brjod nas/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i 'gro ba de rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsams la/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shap+ta dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag pa g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// zhes sogs brjod pas bstod par bsam mo// de nas gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du rtsa rig bkod la/

de las 'od 'phros/ ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sha dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba kar+m+ma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas bsgom bzlas kyis byin rlabs brtan par bsams la/ slar yang bdag nyid mchod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas thal mo sbyar la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags rnams go brjes la/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke dri mchog dang*/ ghan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi t+ye/ rol mo dang*/ shap+ta rnams kyis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra sa twa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hāḥ zhes pas rol mo ci 'byor 'bul lo// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa// rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje sku ste sku che ba// phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog

/rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba// rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba// rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che// phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po// rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa// rdo rje rnon po rno ba che// che ba'i che ba rgya mtsho che// rdo rje pad+ma byang chub che// byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba// rdo rje rgya chen rgya chen te// rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che// rdo rje pad+mo rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che// rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso// rdo rje 'jigs pa srung ba che// rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed// rdo rje ro langs ro langs byed// rdo rje srin po za ba po// rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che// rdo rje gdon te gdon gyi mchog /'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che// rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa// bsgrub dka'i bsgrub pa legs pa ste// rdo rje legs pa dges mdzad pa// rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che// dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa// 'od stug pas ni stug pa che// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po// re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho// rdo rje ye shes ye shes che// rig sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// ha la ha la nag po che// dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa can// rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che// snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba// skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod// glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro// rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul// drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa// nyi ma stong gis gdungs pa'i zhal/ spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po// khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro// phyag rnams du mar mtshon cha brgya// du ma'i zhal te sku yang ston// 'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyil pa ste// sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'// rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul// ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste// 'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar byed// sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can// rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba// zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs pa// sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku// rdo rje rab dges rdo rje sems// kun tu bzang po cher bzang po// mtshan rnams dam pas rnam brgyan pa// khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang*// zhes pas bstod de bdag bskyed do// gnyis pa bum bzlas ni/

rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzangs kyi chu'i gang ba dang*/ rdo rje me tog phreng ba dang bcas pa bzhag la/ de bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha'i gos kyis mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i/ lhor rta'i/ nub tu rma bya'i/ byang du mkha' lding gi khri'i steng dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po nas/ byang du rdo rje dril bu'i bar lha so bdun zhal phyag rdzogs par skad cig gis bskyed/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi ces sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs brjod/ gdan dang mchod pa mdor bsdus phul la/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bsres/ sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ sogs kyis sngags rgyas spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa la sogs pas dbang bskur la/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pas mchod/ lha thams cad pa'i bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ me tog phreng ba nas bzung la bzlas pa bya ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ rtsa rig brgya rtsa brgyad dang lha so so'i sngags ci nus pa bzlas te/ de la/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/

zhes pa gtso bo'i sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba bita hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bita phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bita āḥ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ zhes pas rigs bzhi dang*/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra paṇ+ḍa re de hi de hi sid+dhi bo dhi lo ki ta raṃ pa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa swā hā/ yum bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rwa dza dza/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga ho/ oṃ badz+ra swa dhu dhu/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra te dza r+ya/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu bh+ri/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhīḥ oṃ badz+ra he tu kruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa bhā/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma kaṃ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa k+ṣaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi saṃ/ zhes sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe aḥ lha mo brgyad dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ zhes sgo ba bzhi ste lha so so'i sngags dang*/ khrus kyi don du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ slar yang sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i chu nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas brtan par bya'o// dbang gi bum pa lnga yod na/ bum pa so so'i nang du rigs lnga po re re bskyed/ rtsa rig dang rigs lnga'i sngags bzlas pa nyid do// gsum pa la bzhi/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ de la mchod pa/ bdag 'jug blang ba/ bdag bsgrub cing bzlas pa bya'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bgegs bsal/

oṃ sha zhes dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ bha yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng rin po che'i pha gu'i bskor ba la steng na drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang*/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol tu khyams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug sngon po// phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'od zer phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o// de'i nang du rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba le tshe dgu pa'i phyogs bzhi nas ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang*/ de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris pas mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang*/ rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ khang bzang gnyis ka'i nang gi gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su/ seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i/ lhor rta'i/ nub tu rma bya'i/

byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang*/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyi sgo'i khro bo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs par bsams te rten bskyed pa'o// de nas lha rnams snying po tshig tsam las bskyed de/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā pa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba rtsa zhal shar du gzigs pa phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du oṃ sarba bita hūm̐ las sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba ting nge 'dzin gi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ lhor oṃ sarba bita phaṭa las rgyal mchog rin chen sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu oṃ sarba bita āḥlas shākya rigs dbang ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ byang du oṃ sarba bita tra tha las me tog cher rgyas ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can no// shar lhor oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni hūm̐ las spyan ma dkar mo g.yas pas spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī trāṃ las mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du/ oṃ badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa re de hi de hi sid+dhi bo dhi lo ki ta raṃ pa swā hā las gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa swā hā las sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yon gdan la brten cing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa'o// de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs bzhi la/ rim pa bzhin du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dza las rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ho las rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang gu rdo rje se gol gyis legs so ster ba'o// lho'i rtsibs bzhi la trāṃ las rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing g.yon dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ r+ya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ bh+ri las rdo rje rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o// nub kyi rtsibs bzhi la/ hrīḥlas rdo rje chos dkar la cung zad dmar ba g.yon pad+ma 'dzin cing g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa/ dhīḥlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po g.yas ral gri g.yon posti 'dzin pa/ kruṃ las rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor zhing 'dzin pa/ bha las rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa'o// byang gi rtsibs bzhi la/ kaṃ las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ raṃ las rdo rje bsrung ba ser po rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa/ k+ṣaṃ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar mche ba 'dzin pa/ saṃ las rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis 'dzin pa'o// nang gi grwa bzhi'i shar lhor hūm̐ las sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu trāṃ las phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/

nub byang du hrīḥlas glu ma dkar dmar pi wang 'dzin pa/ byang shar du aḥlas gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o// de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi'i shar lhor hūm̐ las bdug pa ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu trāṃ las me tog ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hrīḥlas mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du aḥlas dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o// shar sgor dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor hūm̐ las rdo rje zhags pa ser po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor baṃ las rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor hoḥlas rdo rje dril bu ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa'o// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha de dag thams cad kyang*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam dang po la phyogs bzhir zla ba'i gdan bzhi bzhi gnas pa rnams kyi steng du/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi sku mdog sngon po/ lhor spos kyi glang po// dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi ser po/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ drwa ba can gyi 'od bzhi dmar po/ byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi ljang gu/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/

rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug gi steng du/ oṃ sogs rtsa rig bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du 'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shwa ri'i bu/ mauṅgal gyi bu/ lhor rab 'byor/ 'char ka ma 'gags pa/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya ya/ nub tu nye ba 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag kun dga' bo/ byang du ming chen/ nor sbyin 'dzin/ gang po 'od srung ste/ nyan thos bcu drug po thams cad kyang lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// snam bu de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bcu gnyis kyi zla ba dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ sogs rtsa ba'i rig pa bcu gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gdung ba sel ba dang snang ba brtsegs pa/ shar lhor 'jigs pa med pa/ lhor dpa' bo 'dul ba dang shes rab mgyogs chen/ lho nub tu ri bo'i rgyal/ nub tu smra ba'i sgra chen dang*/ bse ru lta bu/ nub byang du dug chen 'joms/ byang du rdzu 'phrul cher ston dang*/ seng ge sgra/ byang shar du yid myur rnams dbu'i gtsug tor phyed dang bcas shing drang srong gi cha lugs can/ 'khar gsil dang pusti 'dzin pa chos gos bsnams shing rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// sgo phyi ma bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis rgyab rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re ste bcu drug gi steng du/ oṃ sogs rtsa rig bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang*/ de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo// rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lhor 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ de'i g.yas su dbyug sngon can/

g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub tu 'jig rten gsum 'ching*/ de'i g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgor 'jig rten gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// yang na thams cad sku mdog nag po/ pho brgyad g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ g.yon gyi mo bzhi/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa/ rgyab kyi bzhi lcags kyu sogs nang sgo'i phyag mtshan can du rtsa skya pa bzhed do// phyi'i khor yug gi gdan rnams kyi stang du/ oṃ sogs rtsa rig re re yongs su gyur pa las/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen brgyad/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs pa'i klu chen brgyad/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' chen brgyad/ snar ma dang smin drug la sogs pa'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po la sogs pa'i rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ ma hā bhai ra ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs byed chen po dgu ste/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin rnams dang*/ laṅka mgrin bcu la sogs pa srin po'i tshogs dang*/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa bud med kyi tshogs dang*/ tsartsi ka la sogs pa phra men ma'i tshogs dang*/ wa rā hī la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang ri'i lha dang*/ shing gi lha dang*/ grong gi lha dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs dang ldan zhing so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsams te brten pa bskyed pa'o// de nas ye shes spyan drang ba'i phyir/
