rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs zhing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhad 'gro don mdzad du 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes dang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bha ga wān e h+ye hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hās mchod yon 'bul/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul la/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas// phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa// tshim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na// lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba// chu dang thang skyes yid byung 'di// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ phyogs bcu kun na bdug spos ni// lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs// dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na// lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas// yon tan kun ldan gang yin de// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ye hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi// rin chen mar me la sogs pa// snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de// thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā k+tsit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag bya bar mos la/ sgo ba bzhi'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥs nam mkha'i lha mdun bskyed dang nye bar dgug /oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ gis gzhug oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ gyis phan tshun mi 'bral bar bcing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ lha rnams dbyer med dbang du byas par bsams te/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab cing*/

las la sbyar ba'i phyir sngar gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba'i skabs su lag pa byin gyis brlabs pa de dran par byas la/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs rigs gsum gyi sngags rgyas lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sprad pa dku g.yon du bzhag ngag tu/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig zlos/ tad+ya thā'i tshe/ phyag rgya bkrol la nu ma g.yas dang g.yon snying ga gsum du gar bskor bya zhing swā hā'i bar brjod pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o// de'i rjes su mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcings pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o// ngag tu/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o// sngags brjod pa'i tshe mdun gyi gtso bo'i sku la rtogs shing yid la byed pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o// phyag rgya bkrol nas thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can thams cad ngan song las 'don pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces dang*/ dku g.yon du lag pa gnyis kas se gol gtogs pa ni las la sbyar ba'o// de bzhin du/ oṃ sarba bita hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sbyong ba'i rgyal pos zhes sogs rigs bzhi dang*/ yum bzhi'i sngags sngar bskyed chog tu bshad pa ltar gdon zhing rgyas gdab/ las la sbyar/ de nas oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dza/ rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga ho// rdo rje chags pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu dhu/ rdo rje legs pa ste/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na trāṃ/ rdo rje rin chen dang*/ oṃ badz+ra te dza r+ya/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu bh+ri/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ rdo rje bzhad pa ste lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ rdo rje chos dang*/

oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhīḥ rdo rje rnon po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra he tu kruṃ/ rdo rje rgyu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa bhā/ rdo rje smra ba ste nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ rdo rje las dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje srung ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa k+ṣaṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi saṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur te byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje sgeg mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ rdo rje glu ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥ rdo rje gar ma ste/ nang gi lha mo bzhis kyang sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ rdo rje bdug spos ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ rdo rje me tog ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ rdo rje mar me ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ rdo rje dri chab ma ste phyi'i lha mo bzhis kyang sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgrogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha aḥ rdo rje 'bebs pa ste/ sgo ba bzhis kyang zhes sogs sbyar/ de nas sgo phyi ma'i lha rnams kyi chos rgya rtsa rig 'ba' zhig yin pas de brjod cing*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ drwa ba can gyi 'od/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsigs pa/ kun tu bzang po ste sems dpa' bcu drug gis sogs dang*/ rtsa rig dang*/ 'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mauṅgal gyi bu/ rab 'byor/ 'char ka ma 'gags pa/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya/ nye ba 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag kun dga' bo/

ming chen/ nor 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste/ nyan thos chen po bcu drug gis sogs dang*/ rtsa rig dang*/ gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ 'jigs pa med pa/ dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ ri bo rgyal/ smra ba'i sgra chen/ bse ru lta bu/ dug chen 'joms/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston/ seng ge sgra/ yid myur te/ rang rgyal chen po bcu gnyis kyis sogs dang*/ rtsa rig dang*/ khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ bran bzhi rnams kyis 'gro ba rnams ngan song las 'don pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod/ yang rtsa rig brjod cing*/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs dang*/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs pa'i klu rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs dang*/ nor bu bzang po dang gang ba bzang po la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ laṅka mgrin bcu la sogs pa'i srin po rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa'i bud med rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ smin drug dang snar ma la sogs pa'i rgyu skar rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i rdo rje phra men rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ wa rā hī la sogs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ oṃ sogs/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ 'jigs byed dgu chung ma dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa dang*/ drag po chung ma dang bcas pa dang*/ ri'i lha dang*/ shing gi lha dang*/ grong gi lha dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i lha dang*/ mdor na lo dang*/ zhag dang*/ dus kyi lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod do// byang sems nyan rang man chad la las rgya'i rtsa rig dang*/ chos rgya'i rtsa rig gnyis ma chad pa gal che'o// de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yon pang par gan rkyal du bzhag

de'i steng du g.yas bzhag ste mthe bong gnyis ngos sprad pa ni gtso bo'i dam rgya'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang tha ma bzhi sbyar la bsgreng*/ mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni ngan song sbyong ba'i 'o// phyag rgya gong ma de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal mchog gi'o/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor sbyar la lhag ma 'bar bar byas pa ni shāka thub kyi'o// de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba ni me tog cher rgyas kyi'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i log la mig 'dra bar sbyar/ srin lag dang mthe'u chung nang du bcug pa'i steng mthe bos mnan pa ni spyan ma'i 'o// thal mo sbyar ba las srin lag dang mthe'u chung nang du bcug mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rwa ltar gung mo la ma reg par lta ba ni mā ma kī'i 'o// thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis pad+ma ltar byas la mthe'u chung gnyis so sor phral ba ni gos dkar mo'o// thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas dkris/ mthe bong gung mo la sbyar/ lhag ma bsnol ba ni sgrol ma'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i 'o// de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug pa ni rdo rje rgyal po'i 'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis mda' 'dra bar sbyar ba ni chags pa'i 'o// de nyid slar bkug ste mthe bong gnyis la sbyar nas se gol gtogs pa ni legs pa'i 'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar te tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni rin chen gyi'o// de nyid las sor mo lhag ma rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o// de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi'o// de nyid kha'i thad kar bskor te bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje chos kyi'o// de nyid las rtse mo cung zad bkug pa ni rnon po'i 'o// de nyid gdu bu 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje rgyu'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar byas nas cung zad kha bye ba ni smra ba'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bskyed pa ni las kyi'o// de nyid las shin tu bskyed pa ni srung ba'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo gnyis slar bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o// de nyid mdun du bkug la bsdams pa ni khu tshur gyi'o// rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag pa ni sgeg mo'i 'o// de nyid dpral bar brkyang pa ni phreng ba ma'i 'o// rdo rje thal mo kha nas phyung ba ni glu ma'i 'o// de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa ni gar ma'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa mdun du bzhag pa ni bdug pa ma'i 'o// de nyid las gyen du 'thor ba ni me tog gi'o// mdun du mthe bong gnyis mnyam ste bskor ba ni mar me ma'i 'o// de nyid byug pa ltar byas pa ni dri'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i 'o// de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sbyar ba ni zhags pa'i 'o// de nyid gcig la gcig mdud pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o// de nyid las mthe bong nang du bcug ste bskyod pa ni dril bu'i dam rgya ste rgyud 'dir dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya'ang 'di nyid do// thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo dang srin lag sbyar mthe'u chung nang du bcug

mthe bong gnyis kyi rtsar mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste sbyar ba ni byang sems spyi'i 'o// thal mo snying gar sbyar ba ni nyan thos thams cad kyi'o// g.yon khu tshur nang du bstan te mtheb mdzub sbyar ba bsgreng*/ g.yas mtheb srin sbyar te lhag ma brkyang ba g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub kyi steng du bzhag pa ni rang rgyal rnams kyi'o// rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba rtse sprad tha ma bzhi so sor bsgrengs pa ni 'jig rten gsum snang la sogs pa bcu drug gi'o// thal mo sbyar ba las dbus ma gsum bkug ste rtse sprad tha ma bzhi bskyed pa ni lha rnams kyi'o// thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gshibs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mos ma reg par bkug mthe bong gnyis gshibs la bsgreng*/ lhag ma bsnol ba ni klu rnams kyi'o// lag pa gnyis gyen du gshibs pa'i sen mo rnams so ltar gshibs la mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar cung zad brkyang ba ni gnod sbyin rnams kyi'o// g.yas pa'i snyim pa mgo tshal ltar ston pa ni srin po rnams kyi'o// sor mo bcu phan tshun bsnol ba ni bud med rnams kyi'o// g.yon khu tshur snying gar bsdus la g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa ltar mdzub mo bsgrengs pa ni gza' rnams kyi'o// thal mo gnyis mdun du bkan pa'i gung mo gnyis bkug pa ni rgyu skar rnams kyi'o// lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo bcu'i rtse bkug ste bskrad pa'i snyim pa ni phra men rnams kyi'o// de nyid las mthe bong gnyis nang du lce lta bur byas pa ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi'o// thal mo sbyar ba brkyang la pad skor byas te thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba ni phyogs skyong sogs 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi dam rgya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ me tog ci snyed dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke dri chab dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi t+ye/ rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs kyis rol mo dbul lo// de nas mchod pa nyer lnga pa bya ste/ thog mar oṃ glur blangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas rin po che'i cod paṇa dang*/ de bzhin du/ kuṇ+ḍa laṃ gis rna rgyan dang*/ dar+ṣas mgul rgyan dang*/ a wa hā ras do shal/ ke yū ras dpung rgyan/ pa ri ka ḍa kaṃ gis gdu bu/ pa kaṃ wa las sor gdub/ pā da bha ra ṇaṃ gis rkang rgyan/ ts+tsha traṃ gis gdugs/ dh+wa dzas rgyal mtshan/ pa daṃ kas 'phan/ pa ḍa da mas lda ldi/ tsā ma ras rnga yab/ bi tā naṃ gis bla bre/ siṃ ha ā sa nas seng ge'i gdan/ sha ya nā sa nas gzims cha/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa li dha n+yes pho brang zlum po/ a me ya tsa tur+tha pras pho brang gru bzhi/ dri kū ṭa graṃ gis khang pa nyis brtsegs/ tsan+d+ra ā sa nas zla gdan/ puṣ+pes me tog wī nis pi wang*/ gan+dhes dri/ nai wi t+yes zhal zas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas gos dbul lo// de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las byung ba'i gar sngon du 'gro bas khu tshur gnyis rang gi mgo bo'i steng du 'jog cing dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la rin po che'i cod paṇa bcings par bsam/ de bzhin du/ rang gi rna ba la rna rgyan/ mgul pa la mgul rgyan/ brang la do shal/ lag pa g.yon pas g.yas kyi dpung par dpung rgyan/ mkhrig ma g.yas par gdu bu/ g.yas pa'i gung mo la sor gdub/ lag pa g.yas pas rkang pa g.yas pa'i bol la rkang rgyan te rgyan gyi khyad par brgyad do// g.yon pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur du byas pa'i mthe bo'i steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo gdugs phub pa'i tshul du byas pa gdugs dang*/

rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brtsegs nas g.yon phyogs su rgyal mtshan phrag pa la khur ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis nam mkha' la 'phan 'dogs pa'i tshul dang*/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs nas gung mdzub gnyis brkyang ste steng du lda ldi bre ba'i tshul dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mos rnga yab g.yo ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon pa mnyam bzhag g.yas smin mtshams nas kha thur du bstan pa bla bre 'bul tshul te yo byad kyi khyad par drug go /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs te/ seng ge'i gdan dbul ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon du drang ba gzims chas g.yogs pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas pa'i gung mdzub gnyis kyis pho brang zlum po'i tshul dang*/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis khang pa gru bzhi pa'i tshul dang*/ de nyid kyis khang pa gru bzhi nyis brtsegs dbul ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis zla gdan dbul ba'i tshul te gnas kyi khyad par drug go /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis me tog 'thor ba'i tshul dang*/ de nyid kyis pi wang dang*/ ting shag brdung tshul dang*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis dri'i phye ma 'gyed pa'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bshos 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ de nyid kyis gos 'bul ba'i tshul te mchod pa'i khyad par lnga'o// de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa bya ste/ drug 'gyur gyi glu blangs shing*/ lus kyi gar sngon du 'gro bas so so'i las rgya rnams bcings la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med// oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje chos ni glu blangs pa// oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra nra t+ye aḥ zhes nang gi lha mo bzhis mchod/ yang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa su saṃ gra haṃ/

oṃ dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ badz+ra dharma gā ya nai/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra karma ka rod+bha wai/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ zhes phyi'i lha mo bzhis mchod do// de la lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa dku gnyis su gdengs te bzhag lus 'dud pa ltar byas pa ni sgeg mo'i 'o// khu tshur gnyis smin mtshams kyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad du phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul byas pa ni phreng ba ma'i 'o// khu tshur gnyis kyis kha nas tshig dbyung ba'i tshul byas pa ni glu ma'i 'o// rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bzhag ste g.yas su bskor ba ni gar ma'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis 'og tu blugs pa ltar byas pa ni bdug spos ma'i 'o// de nyid gyen du 'thor ba ltar byas pa ni me tog ma'i 'o// de nyid las mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa ni mar me ma'i 'o// de nyid las thal mo gshibs te brkyang pa dri'i byug pa ltar byas pa ni dri chab ma'i 'o// de nas oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul te/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ zhes brjod cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes pa 'gre/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+na= blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog

/ma hā ta rat+na= glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab bzhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na= rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṃ ga= dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na= zhes brjod cing dbul/ de la lag pa gnyis mkhrig ma bsnol te rgyab sbyar la sor mo rnams phan tshun 'khyud nas mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug pa ni 'khor lo'i 'o// khu tshur gnyis sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i tshigs bcag la mthe bong gnyis dang sbyar ba ni nor bu'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis bsgrengs pa'i logs la mdzub mo gnyis bcer te bzhag pa ni btsun mo'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi gshibs te bsgrengs pa ni blon po'i 'o// g.yas glang po'i sna ltar brkyang ba'i gru mo g.yon pas bzung ba ni glang po'i 'o// khu tshur gnyis gshibs la gung mo dang srin lag gnyis brkyangs la rtse sbyar mthe bong gnyis rna ba ltar byas pa ni rta'i 'o// g.yon pa go cha 'dzin pa ltar byas la/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin bya ba ni dmag dpon gyi phyag rgya'o// de nas 'dod yon lnga dbul te// kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul gyis// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzī te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig=

/shap+ta= /phyogs dus kun nas tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /gan+dhe= /phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /ra sa= /phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyan 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /spar+ṣe= /zhes pas mchod do// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs snyan pas bstod de/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la// me long ye shes rang bzhin las// sems can ma lus thams cad kyi// ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa// phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la// mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gyis// sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa// rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal// so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab pad+mo kha rgyas pa// khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po// shākya rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal// nan tan ye shes phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun// ma lus par ni zhi mdzad pa// me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal// grwa yi phyogs ni kun du yang*// rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur bstan pa// lha mo spyan dang mā ma kī// dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal// rtsibs kyi nang nas thams cad na// bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams// rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs// don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog

/phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la// rdo rje chags pa bde chen po// rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa// bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la// rdo rje legs pa sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che// rab dgyes rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dges khyod la// rdo rje rin chen rdo rje don// rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che// nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la// rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba// rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od// rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la// sems can don yod rdo rje dpal// rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed// rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpal khyod la// rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che// rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che// dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la// rdo rje chos rab de nyid don// rdo rje pad+ma rab dga' byed// 'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje spyan// phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la// rdo rje rno ba theg pa che// rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po// 'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab// phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo khyod la// rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che// rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po// rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba// phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying po la// rdo rje gsung ba rang rig mchog /rdo rje bzlas pa rab bsgrub phyir// mi gsung rdo rje mchog bsgrub pa// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la// rdo rje las rab rdo rje'i bka'// las kyi rdo rje kun rab 'gro// rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba// phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la// rdo rje srung ba brtan pa che// rdo rje go cha sra ba che// brtson 'grus mchog ni thub par dka'// phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la// rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po// rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che// bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa// phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la// rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab btud nyid// rdo rje 'ching ba rab grol byed// rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog

/phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la// rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma// mi dmigs rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas// rdo rje sgeg mo'i tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gying ma la// rnam dag rdo rje yon tan te// yid bzhin rdo rje re ba skong*// rdo rje gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje phreng ba la// rnam dag rdo rje'i gsung mchog ma// rdo rje pi wang 'dzin pa'i tshul// rdo rje gsung mchog sgrogs pa'i don// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la// rnam dag rdo rje las rab ster// las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gar mkhan la// sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma// tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pa'i// rdo rje phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje bdug pa la// rdo rje mdzes pa'i tshul 'dzin cing*// rdo rje me tog 'thor ba'i tshul// byang chub yan lag me tog ste// phyag 'tshal rdo rje me tog la// 'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// rdo rje'i spyan gyis ma rig sel// rdo rje gsal byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje snang byed la// rdo rje tsan+dan bdud rtsi'i chu// rdo rje dri yis rnam rtog 'joms// rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dri mchog la// rnam dag skul byed rdo rje'i don// rdo rje sdud mdzad rdo rje'i don// rdo rje 'gugs byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags kyu la// mi gtong rdo rje chos kyi don// rdo rje 'dren pa mi 'gyur don// 'ching mdzad rdo rje phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje zhags pa la// rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bdag /rdo rje mgyogs byed glog bzhin 'gyur// sgrog mdzad rdo rje phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags sgrog la// rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag

/bskyod mdzad rdo rje kun gyi las// rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la// sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi// byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni// rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i// byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i rtag 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed 'khar gsil posti phyag /bslabs sbyangs yon tan kun ldan pa'i// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rten 'brel don la brten gnas pa'i// 'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni// 'byung dang ldog la rab zhugs pa'i// rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can// sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan cing*// stag lpags kyis ni smad dkris pa'i// 'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal// phyi yi 'khor yug la gnas pa'i// 'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar dang*// phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing*// 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi// zhes pas bstod de/ 'das pa'i lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas bran la/ ༈ /dang po phyogs skyong dang*/ gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la cha gsum ltar dbul/ ༈ /gsum pa/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ a wa lo ki te/ om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa bdun brjod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la= gzugs dam pa la= sku 'byam klas la= 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin no// rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig thams cad sdug bsngal las grol nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces pas rigs drug la bsngo/ bzhi pa byin gyis brlab pa nas sangs rgyas bzhi'i mtshan gyi bar sngar bzhin byas la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di yi dwags kyi 'gro ba thams cad la sbyin no// gnod pa med par tshim nas bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las grol ba dang myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod do//

༈ /lnga pa khro bo'i nga rgyal dang gsang sngags cung zad bzlas la/ cha gsum ltar bgegs gtor sbyin/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor la/ khro bo'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad de 'jig rten pa gtor mas mchod pa'i cho ga'o// ༈ /gsum pa bdag 'jug blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gis sngar kun rig gi dbang bskur zhus pa'i bla mar mos la/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug nas dbang zhu bar bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing 'jug pa rnams rdzogs par blangs/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur gyi tshigs bcad dang smon lam rnams bor la/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin kyi bka'i dbang bskur ba'i bar rdzogs par blangs la/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// ༈ /bzhi pa bdag bsgrub cing bzlas pa bya ba ni/ dbang thob pa'i sgrub pa pos mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs la bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra/ zhes pas sbyong rgyal dang bdag tha mi dad du bsam/ de bzhin du rat+na dha ras rgyal mchog pad+ma dha ras shāka thub/ bi shwa dha ras dkyil 'khor gyi me tog cher rgyas dang bdag tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal gzung*/ ta thā ga ta sa ma ya mā ti kra ma ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dha ra āt+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad spro ba po rnam snang dang bdag tha mi dad cing grogs gcig par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra/ rat+na dha ra/ pad+ma dha ra/ bi shwa dha ra/ ta thā ga ta dha ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dha ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes lan gsum du brjod cing*/ nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'thon te/ sngar gyi gnas su 'dug la dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i ched du lha so so'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang rtsa ba'i rig pa ci nus su bzlas la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab bo// gnyis pa slob ma rjes su gzung ba la gnyis/ tshe ldan dbang gis rjes su gzung ba/ tshe 'das sdig sbyong thams cad kyis rjes su gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ slob ma dge bsnyen la sogs pa so so thar pa'i sdom pa gang rung dang ldan zhing*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa khrus byas te gral la 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du ngan song thams cad sbyong ba kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus la/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bsrung snyam pa gyis zhes bsgo/ de la slob ma sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis kyi dang po la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btab pa kha bskangs nas rgyun bshags bya ste/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*// rjes su yi rangs yang na bgyid stsal gang*// de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni// spyan snga da ltar ma lus so sor bshags// bde gshegs sras kyis tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*// rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don// sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang*// rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing*// blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom// ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang zhugs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi// blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' rwa ba ste// dman pas 'jigs pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal// srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog

/gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing*// blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje che ldan pa'i// brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*// srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid// 'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa'i// snying rje rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtog /mnyam med byang chub sems ni gzung bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am// yang na yongs su bskyab par bya phyir ram// rang gi sems nyid dag par bya ba'i phyir// 'di dag thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du btang*// de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa 'di// bdag dang gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir// skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom par bgyi// bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yi// chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni// 'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir// khyad 'phags gnas la bdag gis gnas par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug sa ma ya aḥzhes brjod de/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsams la/ rdo rjes reg cing*/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par bsam/ de nas sdom pa ma lus pa gzung ba'i bsam pas thal mo sbyar la/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni lan drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma grol ba ni grol bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod du bcug ste sems bskyed pa'o// de nas rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas slob ma'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/

yang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis/ snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs dang*// dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas// zhes pa ltar gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su gtugs shing*/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod la byin gyis brlabs pas slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur par bsams la/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal 'dzin du bcug ste byin gyis brlabs pa'o// de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gyi go 'phang thob par rgyur cig ces brjod de smon lam btab bo// de nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung bskal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes bsgos pas gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed de chos bshad pa'o// de nas/

oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha/ a na lārka ma hā badz+ra kro dhā/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pa ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra prā ṇāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas slob ma'i gnas gsum du gtugs te/ bsrung bar bya ba ni slob ma sta gon no// de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir du yon phul la/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ ras dmar pos mig bcing*/ sngags de nyid kyis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes pas slob ma rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo mnyam pas me tog bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam/ de nas gtso bo la sogs pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ gi rnam par byon nas/ slob ma'i lus la char babs pa bzhin zhugs/ yang snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ye shes hūm̐ gi rnam pas zhugs par bsams la/ slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bsdams pa bzhag cing*/ oṃ badz+ra prā be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes bcu nas brgya'i bar brjod pas dbab bo// de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ a sa me/ tri sa me/ ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing brtan par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du song la/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni// 'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis// dman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra pra ti gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog dkyil 'khor du ltos pa med par dor la/ gang la phog pa'i lha ngo shes par bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog blang ste/ slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod do// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra ha se uṅgha ṭā ya hūm̐ gis gdong g.yog dkral/ oṃ badz+ra pā sh+ya hos dkyil 'khor bstan la/

gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa'i tshul mdor bsdus pa bshad/ khyod kyi me tog phog pa'i lha 'di yin no zhes ma brjed pa 'dzin du gzhug de nas oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas dam tshig thams cad rgyud la gnas par bsam/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying gar gtugs te/ kun rig snying gar bzhags par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hṛ da ya me prā be sha ḍi ḍa tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas brtan par bsam mo// de nas rnam rgyal gyi bum chu blud cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni// de ma thag tu bkas nas gshegs// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang*// bdun rgyud rigs rnams brlag par byed// de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang*// sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'// shin du mos pas bsrung bar bya// zhes pas dam tshig bsgrag cing*/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// ma byin pa yang blang mi bya// rdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams// dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min// chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni// nam yang bya ba ma yin no// dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spong*// dus kun du ni byang chub sems// snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// lha dang bla ma de bzhin no// sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang*// bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya// lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang*// de yi grib ma yang 'gom mi bya// phyag rgya'i gzugs la de bzhin no// lha dang sngags la smad mi bya// gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min// mu stegs can la smad mi bya// mdor na yid gnyis the tshom som nyi mi bya ste// bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no// zhes brjod pas sdom pa sbyin te 'jug pa'i cho ga'o//

༈ //gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang mtha' rten sbyin pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab pa kha bskangs la/ mdun gyi gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnam pa sngags rnams kyi yig 'bru gser btso ma'i mdog can dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma me tog gang phog gi lha'am/ rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms pa'i spyi bor zhugs par bsams la/ rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bita hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bita phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bita āḥ o sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ sarba bita oṃ/ oṃ sarba bita swa/ oṃ sarba bita aḥ oṃ sarba bita hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ sha// oṃ bha/ zhes sngags bcu gsum po brjod cing slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzung ste sngags kyi dbang ngo*// de nas nam mkhar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang slob dpon lhan cig tu slob ma la dbang bskur bar bsams la/ rigs lnga'i bum pa'am med na rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhiṣañca hrīḥ oṃ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes chu dbang lan lngar bskur/ 'thung du yang bcug ste chu'i dbang ngo*// de nas dbu rgyan byin la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod cing phyag rgyas kyang dbang bskur/ de nas rin po che'i phreng ba dbu rgyan gyi rtsa chings su byin la/ oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/

zhes brjod kha dog lnga pa'i dar gyi cod paṇa byin la/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṭa laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ zhes brjod de/ dbu rgyan phreng ba dar dpyangs gsum ni cod paṇa gyi dbang ngo*// de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang*/ phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu byin la/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu dra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu dra a bhi ṣiñca trāṃḥ oṃ pad+ma mu dra a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma mu dra a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod de rdo rje'i dbang dang dril bu'i dbang ngo*// de nas/ slob dpon dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rigs lnga'i ming 'dogs par bsams la/ oṃ bud+dha nā ma a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na nā ma a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma nā ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma nā ma a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod cing me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i ming btags pa ni ming gi dbang ste/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rigs pa'i dbang lnga'o// de dag brtan pa'i phyir du sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñca zhes brjod de rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ zhes dang*/ 'khor lo lag tu gtad pa'am/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya gtugs pa'i rkyen gyis slob ma seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rnam snang chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpar gyur par bsgom/ de la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa la/ thog mar/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca hrī hrī hrīḥ oṃ karma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca a a aḥ

zhes brjod cing*/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje dril bu dkrol/ dpon slob gnyis kas rigs lnga'i phyag chen bcas pas slob ma rigs lnga spro ba po rnam snang rdor sems su gyur par bsams te phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig go /de nas rdo rje/ chos 'byung*/ pad+ma/ spyan/ ut+pal ste/ yum lnga'i phyag mtshan spyi bor bzhag cing*/ mthar lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ oṃ bud+dha dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod cing*/ dran pa dang shes rab dang ldan par gyis shig ces te dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi don to// de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te/ mthar lag pa g.yas su byin la/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod la thabs ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa skyed cig par gdams te rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi don to// de nas rdo rje dang dril bu lag tu byin la/ oṃ pra dz+nyā u pa yo ga sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ aḥzhes brjod la/ de ltar khyod rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pas thabs shes rab stong pa dang*/ snying rje chen po mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces dang*/ de nas/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi// phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi// nga yis ci ltar bsgo ba bzhin// khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so// zhes brjod do// gsum pa ni rin po che sna bdun gyi gzugs lag tu gtad pa'am phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ wasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ ma ha ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/

oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ tu raṃ ga a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnas skabs su 'khor los sgyur ba'i/ rgyal srid dang mthar thug chos kyi rgyal po rnam snang gi go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ro// zhes bsgos la bka'i dbang bskur te/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*// 'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang*// sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob 'gyur na// lha yi bde ba smos ci dgos// sangs rgyas kun dang bla mar mnyam// rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni// rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur bas// slob dpon nyid la brnyas mi bya// rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang*// rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni// rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya// rtag tu 'khon dang gcugs mi bya// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya'o// bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang*// dam tshig las ni 'da' ba dang*// de sogs byed pa tshar bcad na// 'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsung*// sems can kun la shas cher chags// bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par gyur// zhes pas dam tshig bsrung bar gdams nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes khas blangs nas/ slob dpon la ci nus pa'i yon dbul lo// dbang gi tshig rgyas pa la spro na/ gzhan phan 'od zer du blta'o// ༈ //gnyis pa ni/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu tshe 'das rjes su 'dzin na/ sngar sbyong ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyang stegs khru gang ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa bri/ de steng du rus pa'am ming byang bzhag sbyang ba'i yo byad dang*/ bye ma'am yungs kar sogs gshin don la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bsham mo// de nas bdag 'jug yan chad rdzogs par bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs rnams su bye ma'am yungs kar la sngags kyi brabs la bzhag go

/de nas ming byang la sogs pa'i rten de/ ya k+ṣas bsang*/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyang stegs kyi steng du/ tshe 'das kyi ming gi yi ge dang po'am/ nṛ las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bltas la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ dang*/ tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i nṛ las 'od 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes khams gsum gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsam/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la ngag tu/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa gsum dang*/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ ā pa na ye hūm̐/ zhes pas bar do'am rigs drug gang na gnas pa nas bkug nas rten la thim par bsam mo// de nas sdig pa dral ba'i phyir lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis sbyar/ tha ma bzhi rtse sprad par mnye zhing*/ oṃ sarba bita sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba ā pa ya/ ban+dha ni pra mok+ṣa ya/ sarba ā pa ya ga ti bh+yaḥsarba sa twāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes brjod pas sdig pa dor la rdo rje bsdams pa dral zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha tra thas sdig pa dral nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis spyi bo la sogs par gtugs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bita badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ya hūm̐ gis rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med par bsam mo// de nas bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir gtor ma rten la bskor zhing*/

oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis zhi bas sbyang*/ sum+bha brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing ting lo dang chang bu rten la bskor ba gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs nas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyang ba la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad la gtor ma 'di lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod/ de nas srung 'khor ltar khro bo rnams spyan drang*/ mchod bstod byas la/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes dang*/ rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo drag tu bya'o// sum+bha sogs drag sngags mang du brjod pas bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo// de nas tshe 'das kyi sdig pa thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas sna bug nas 'thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim/ de g.yas su me dang*/ g.yon du chur dor bas sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg cing sbyang bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsreg cing chur dor ro// de nas bye ma'am yungs kar la rtsa rig la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi sngags mang du bzlas pa de'i nus pa bstims la/

rus pa'am ming byang mdun du bzhag pa la brabs te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇā ni bhasmi ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bruṃ bi nā sha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ta ka ta ka ha na ha na ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang*/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dag par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas khrus byas te/ dbang gi bum pa yod na me tog cher rgyas kyi bum pas bkru zhing*/ med na rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la thog mar dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta sogs kyis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o// de nas khrus byas pa'i chu de slar yang bum pa'i nang du blugs la/

de nas bum chus nub gong ma rnams la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/ tha ma la rten la dngos su bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya'o// de bzhin du tshig rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab rnams gzhug rkang pa gnyis pa'i ser sna'i gnas su/ khrims 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal rnams bcug la/ tshig bzhi pa lnga dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes bya ba'i tshig bzhi pa re re dang rtsa rig re spel zhing bkrus nas/ mthar tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs dag nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi par/ bcom ldan dam chos/ dam chos bden pas dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun/ dge 'dun bden pas/ zhes sogs sbyar ba'i tshig bzhi pa gnyis brjod cing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// chu me rlung du 'don pa bsgyur ba'i tshig bzhi pa gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/

tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces bya ba dang*/ bum pa'i chus gtor/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yis// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsung zhing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// chos kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyod la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyod la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig

/sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun du bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod la/ de nas bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang 'dzin du bcug cing*/ phyag byed du gzhug la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyobs pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa rnam sel ba// bdag ni skyabs su mchi lags so// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// kun du bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi// lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la// phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrags nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jig pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi pa dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod cing gsol ba 'debs par bsam mo// de nas gshin po la dbang mi bskur na 'og gi byang bu bsreg pa dang*/ lam sbyang bstan sogs rdzogs par bya/ dbang bskur na skabs 'dir bya dgos pas maṇ+ḍal phul nas rjes zlos byed par bsam zhing*/ dbang med bdag gis sogs rgyun bshags bya ba nas brtsams te/ 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun dbang bcu dgu po thams cad rdzogs par bskur ro// de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe 'das lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la mchod yon la sogs pa sngags tsam gyis mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che la sogs pa sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod la/ lam sbyang bstan bya'o// yul kha cig na zas gtad dang*/ gos l+h+wam gtod pa sogs kyi lugs yod pa de ltar byed dgos byung na/ sngar ltar mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes la 'dod yon sna tshogs pas tshe 'das lhar gyur pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs 'dod yon gyis tshig gis mchod do// nub tha ma la byang bu bsreg par byed na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam zhing me sbar la/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ rtsa rig brjod cing bsreg go /de nas lam sbyang bstan bya ste/ nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes la bya/ nub tha ma la byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la bya ste/ dril bu gsil/ me tog gtor/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog

/oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne/ rat+ne saṃ bha we/ rat+na ki rat+ne/ rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra tha/ zhes dang*/ rol mo bya/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we ma hā su kha wa tī gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo byas te/ bde ba can du skyes par bsam/ der skyes pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis phyis kyi de la mchod par bsams la/ mchod cing rol mo bya/ des kyang*/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med 'khor bcas la mchod cing rol mo bya/ der skyes pa'i rgyu brtags pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i nus pa yin par shes te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor la mchod cing rol mo byas la/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces ched du brjod par bsam/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod pas/ mchod cing rol mo bya/ slar bde ba can du song bar bsams la me tog dor ro// de nas tshe 'das kyi don du bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgyas par brjod cing*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis rgyas btab ste/ gshin po rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ gshin don yin na/ lam sbyang bstan tshar ba'i rjes dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur yin na dbang chog tshar ba'i rjes sam/ sgrub mchod rkyang pa yin na/ mdun bskyed brtan byed kyi bzlas pa tshar ba'i rjes su/ cho ga 'di rnams bya ste/ bdag bskyed ltar bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca sogs kyi sngags rgyas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab/ bh+ri ta sogs kyi sngags rgyas byin rlabs brtan par bsgom/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags rgyas bdag dang gnas la sogs pa'i bar chad bsrung*/

de nas mdun bskyed kyi mthar ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa gsar pa bshams pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas mdun bskyed la phul bar bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yis// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas khyod la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// badz+ra puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// badz+ra dhū pe/ mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed cing*// phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di// kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// badz+ra ā lo ke lhan cig skyes dang sbyang ba yi// dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni// rang byung nyid la 'bul lags kyis// kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol// badz+ra gan+dhe/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i// bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul// badz+ra nai wi t+ye/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston cing*// shes rab mchog gis rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra// bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi// don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /shab+da zhes dang rol mo dbul/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing*/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces sogs nas/ rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi'i bar sh+lo+auka bdun gyi rjes su/ sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu// gar ma mchod pa'i lha mo dang*// sbos ma me tog mar me ma// dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal// sgo bzhi'i dbus na legs bzhugs shing*// dad sogs ngo bo rnam dag pa// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// sgo srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams byang zhing dag pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum la sogs pa brjod pa'i rjes su/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes byas gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa// de ni mgon pos bzod par mdzod// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas// ma 'byor ma rnyed ma 'tshal ba// 'dir ni bgyi pa gang bgyis rnams// de dag thams cad bzod par mdzod// ces sogs kyis cho ga lhag chad kha bskang zhing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ rgyal ba thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas shing me tog dor ro// de nas dril bu gsil zhing*/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog

/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar gyur cig ces brjod nas/ rol mo byas shing me tog dor ro// slar yang bsngo ba rnam par dag pa btab la/ ras bris bkur sti dang bcas pas bsdus la dben par bzhag mchod rdzas dman pa rnams mgon med pa dang phongs pa la sbyin/ gos zung sogs mchod rten dang sangs rgyas kyi sku la phul nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// dpal ldan ngan song kun sbyong cho ga'i rim// rgyud dang rin chen bzang po'i bshad srol dang*// rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun gsung rab ltar// 'khrul med go bde'i ngag gis rnam par sbyar// dge ba gang des ma gyur 'gro ba rnams// sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas las rnam grol zhing*// rnam dag byang chub spyod pas rgyud sbyangs nas// khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur bar shog /kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la/ lha rigs byang chub sems dpa' gu ge chos kyi rgyal pos thog mar bka' stsal zhing*/ bar du dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mang pos bskul ba dang*/ mthar mdo dang sngags kyi sde snod rab tu mang po la sbyangs shing zab mo'i don la dad pa thob pa/ sde snod 'dzin pa bsam 'grub bzang pos yang yang du bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ rnga chen gyi lo tha skar gyi zla ba'i nyer lnga la dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can mtha' yas pa la phan thog par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rdul tshon kha skong ngam nyer mkho bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' mchog

/khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad la// btud de ngan song sbyong ba yi// dkyil 'khor cho ga'i kha skong bri// 'dir kun rig gi chog la ras bris dang*/ rdul tshon la brten pa gnyis las/ dang po shes sla ba dang nyin gcig la cho ga rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de'i tshul kho bos gzhan phan mtha' yas su bkod zin la/ 'dir gzhung de la ltos pa'i dbang du byas nas rdul tshon gyi phyogs brjod na don gnyis te/ sngon du bsnyen pa dang dkyil 'khor las rim mo// dang po ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ rtsa rig 'bum phrag gsum mam drug bzla/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes la bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ gnas skabs su gtor ma dang*/ bskor ba dang*/ tsha tsha sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// gnyis pa la sa'i cho ga sta gon gyi cho ga dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bri ba'i gnas su/ cha gsum ltar gtor ma gsum bsham/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ gu gul sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bshams la/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong la dbul ba'i mthar/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mthar phyin pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de/ phyogs skyong la bslang ba'o// de nas gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la phul la/ 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing zhes sogs brjod pas bslang ste/ 'di gnyis ni zhi bas bslang ba'o// de nas bgegs gtor bsngos la/ gdon khyod rang gi gnas su song*// zhes pa'i mjug tu sa phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i 'byung po gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bsgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren gyi rigs gang yod pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/

sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces brjod la/ gtor ma sgo drung du dor/ khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo drag tu bya/ sa phyogs gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs pas bgegs rnams byer bar bsam pa ni drag pos bslang ba ste sa bslang ba'i cho ga'o// de nas 'byung po dang phyogs skyong rnams gshegs su gsol/ rang rdor sems kyi nga rgyal gyis/ rtsa rig zlos bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su lag pa gnyis bzhag la/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ zhes nyer gcig sogs brjod pas sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas pas sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams te sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba'o// de nas rtsa rig zlos bzhin du dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa'i sa gzhi mchod pa'i gzhi dang bcas pa dri bzangs kyi chus byug ga dar legs par bya ba ni las dang bya bas sbyang ba ste sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o// de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bzung la/ bdag gis sa'i phyogs 'dir 'phags pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor bris la/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya'o zhes sems bskyed pa ni blos bzung ba'o// de nas rjes chog tu bshad pa ltar bdag nyid la dbang bskur la/ byin gyis brlab pa/ me ltar 'bar bas bsrung ba rnams byas nas/ bkra shis brjod de nub dang po sa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa sta gon la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ sa chog byas pa'i gnas su thig chen brgyad tsam mam 'og nas 'byung ba ltar las thig rdzogs par btab la/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu tshang bar bkod/ mtha' skor du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang bum pa rnams bsham/ de nas dpon slob rnams stan la 'khod de/

mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ bum pa sta gon/ lha sta gon/ sbyin sreg sta gon/ slob ma stan gon no// dang po ni/ rnam rgyal bum par dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang*/ dbang gi bum par rigs lnga bskyed cing bzlas pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs te gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed/ me tog tshom bu rnams gdan du bsam pa'i steng du/ lha rnams snying po tshig tsam las bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug rgyas gdab las la sbyar ba rnams bya/ de nas mchod pa rgyas pa dang gtor ma'i bar byas la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la blta zhing*/ pus mo g.yas btsugs spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas nang par spyan drang ba'i phyir snyan gsan dbab ste/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de bas gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs// sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*// gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// gang yang lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can stan la dga' ba rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming*// ngan song sbyong ba ci nus kyi// cho ga bzhin du bri lags na// bdag dang slob mar bcas rnams la// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// gsum pa ni sta gon gyi lha mchod pa'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/

ma grub na 'gal ba med do// bzhi pa ni slob ma la dbang bskur byed na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams gral la 'khod pa la/ rgyun bshags dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ chos bshad pa/ bsrung ba bya ba rnams byas la btang ngo*/ tshe 'das kyi don byed na/ rten bskyed pa nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba'i bar byas la/ de'i rjes su lam sbyang bstan bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ bdag nyid la dbang bskur ba nas brtsams te mchod pa dang bstod pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba rnams byas la/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la/ rnam snang gi dam rgya dang rtsa rig lan gsum gyi mthar badz+ra muḥces phyag rgya dkrol nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gsheg nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes gshegs par gsol ba btab la/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ lan gsum dang*/ badz+ra muḥzhes se gol gtogs pas lha rnams sang 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes bzhin pa'i sgo nas gshegs par bsam mo// de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod de// nub gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i bya ba gnyis/ dang po la/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ bsgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis kyi dang po la/ thig gis bri ba ni/ dang po thig chen brgyad btab la// de la cha chen bcu drug bya// phyi nas thig thung cha re bsnan// dbus nas cha chen gsum pa'i mthar/ 'khor lo'i phyi thig zlum por bskor// slar yang dbus nas cha phran bdun// gdung zlum phyi thig zlum por bskor// tshangs pa'i mdun du cha phran gnyis// gtso bo'i gnas yin cha phran phyed// ka ba'i don du gdab par bya// cha phran bzhi dor sbyang rgyal gnas// rdo rje'i gdung zlum cha phran phyed// phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng la// slar yang cha phran phyed nyid do// 'khor lo cha phran bzhi yis bskor// mu khyud cha phran phyed nyid do// cha chen bzhi pa phyed du gdab// nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// phyi ma phyed gdab phyi ma'ang phyed// sgo dang ya phub ka rgyan sogs// thams cad spyi dang mthun par gdab// cha chen lnga pa phyed mar bya// dbus su nang ma'i rta babs te// g.yas g.yon phyi ma'i lha snam yin// drug pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// bdun pa phyed gdab phyi ma phyed// brgyad cha'i sgo dang ya phub dang*// mun pa ka ba ka rgyan sogs// dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun pa'o// brgyad pa rta babs cha bzhi ste// dgu pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// zur thig rtse nas cha chen gcig

/zlum por bskor ba khor yug ste// cha phran gnyis kyis rdo rwa dang*// cha chen gcig gis me ri bya// zhes pa ltar ro// de'i steng du/ ye shes thig gis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir ras kyi thig skud kha dog lnga pa ring ba la dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur/ sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha'i tshad dang ldan pa rnams mdun du gser snod la sogs pa'i nang du bzhag ste/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig skud dkar po/ oṃ las kun rig sngon po hūm̐ las sbyong rgyal/ ser po trāṃ las rgyal mchog dmar po hrīḥlas shākya rigs dbang*/ ljang gu aḥlas me tog cher rgyas rnams su bskyed/ rang gi mig gnyis dzaḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba bsams la/ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi aṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes pas mig la bkod de/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la rdo rje'i thig stsol cig ces dang*/ dīp+ta sogs brjod pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu bkug ste/ mdun gyi srad bu la thim pas srad bu yi shes kyi ngo bor bsam/ de nas rigs lnga zhugs te srad bu so so la thim par bsam zhing rtsa rig gsum la sogs pa bzlas/ de nas slob ma dang lhan cig tu/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥs+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharmaḥ a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥzhes brjod cing*/ dang po so sor bsgril/ de nas gcig tu bsgril/ rtsa rig zlos shing dri bzangs kyis byug rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rdo rje dril bu dang thig skud bzung la/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi bden bral dang*/ grogs dbang ldan du gnas te/ sarba bita/ zhes pas rang kun rig dang*/ badz+ra karmas grogs rdo rje las su mos la/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzaḥbarjod cing blangs la/ gnyis char gyi g.yon pa'i khu tshur dril bu dang bcas pas lte ba'i thad kar bzung ngo*// de nas phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsam/

rang nyid badz+ra satwa ces rdor sems kyi nga rgyal gyis nub dang*/ grogs shar du song la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas nam mkha' dang sa gzhi la tshangs thig dang po btab/ de bzhin du rang lho dang*/ slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ me dang dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig rlung dang bden bral du gnas pas nub/ de nyid dang dbang ldan du gnas pas byang*/ me dang bden bral du gnas pas lho/ rang de nyid dang*/ slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ bden bral dang dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab/ logs thig 'debs pa'i rtsig thig phyi nang gnyis 'dod snam gyi thig ste gsum gsum btab po// de nas slob dpon gyis nub sgo nas/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ zhes thig nam mkhar bteg la/ rang 'jig rten gsum rgyal du mos pa'i mig gnyis/ hrīḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rjer mos la/ kro dha dṛṣ+ṭi hrīḥ zhes brjod cing sgo bzhir bltas pas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bsal bar bsams la/ sgo phyi nang gi thad kyi rtsa thig dbye ste thig gi cho ga'o// de nas rdul tshon dkar po la oṃ/ sngon po la hūm̐/ ser po la trāṃ/ dmar po la hrīḥ ljang gu la aḥbris la phyogs ma nor bar bkod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshon dkar po oṃ las kun rig sogs thig skud ltar bskyed/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi tshon rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can spyan drangs la bstims nas/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig dang*/ rigs lnga'i sngags bdun bdun bzlas te byin gyis brlabs/ rigs lnga la mchod nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdul tshon du bsam mo// de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis tshon blangs la/

oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ zlos shing dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i rtsig pa lnga'i sar phyi nas sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dbang ldan nas g.yas skor gyis sgo tshad gcig gi bar du bri/ de la mchod nas/ rin po che'i snod kyis bkab la steng du rdo rje bzhag pas bsrung*/ phyis sbrel ran pa dang*/ snod bsal la ngan na phyir bzlog bya/ bzang na spro ba bskyed do// de nas slob ma sogs thams cad kyis bris te/ tshon gyi kha dog phal che ba mngon rtogs kyis shes la/ nang gi ka ba sngon po la shar gyi ka ba gnyis la rdo rje sngon po/ lho'i ka ba gnyis la rin po che ser po/ nub kyi la pad+ma dmar po/ byang gi la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ gdung zlum sngon po la rdo rje ser pos mtshan pa bri/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs phyi nang gnyis kyi bar sngon po/ dkyil phyogs mdog mu khyud phyi nang gnyis sngon po/ 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa phyed gzhi sngon po la phreng ba ci mdzes/ mda' yab dang pu shu khra bo/ rta babs kyi ka ba phyogs mdog ka rgyan sna tshogs/ rta babs kyi snam bu dang po dmar/ gnyis pa sngon po/ gsum pa ljang gu/ bzhi pa ser po bri/ glang rgyab kyi nang sngon po la drwa phyed sna tshogs pad+ma dkar dmar chos 'khor ser po/ gdugs sna tshogs/ khang bzangs phyi ma'i rdo rje'i rwa rnams phyogs mdog khyams ljang gu/ khor yug gi phyi'i rdo rje'i rwa ba'i gzhi nag po la/ rdo rje ser po'am dkar po/ de'i phyi rol me ri sna tshogs su bri/ de nas lha rnams kyi gnas su/ rang rang gi sku dngos su bzhag pa'am ma 'byor na ming ngam/ thig le'am/ gdan tsam bkod do// bri tshar ba dang*/ thig tshon gyi lha la mchod bstod byas nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ tshon gyis bri ba ste dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ rdul tshon gyi mthar dri bzang po'i chus byug
