der mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham pa sogs byas la/ sgrub pa po thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du 'dug la mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bsgom/ bum pa bzlas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pa'am rgyas pa spro bsdus las bskyed na/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ sarba bita sogs dang*/ mtha' skor du rtsa rig sbrul 'khyil ba lta bus bskor ba de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus snying po la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das kun rig sogs bskyed pa nas brtsams te byang sgo'i gdan gyi dbus su ho ljang gu'i mtha' skor du oṃ sogs rtsa rig las 'od zer 'phros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje dril bu sku mdog ljang gu zhes sogs kyis bskyed/ sgo phyi ma dang khor yug gi lha rnams rtsa rig kho na'i 'od zer spro bsdu las bskyed/ mdangs gshegs su gsol ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim/ rgyas gdab/ las la sbyar te dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// de la mchod pa 'bul/ gtor ma rnams gtong*/ bdag 'jug bya/ bdag rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang tha mi dad du bskyed cing brtan byed du bzlas pa bya/ grub na dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gam zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ sgrub mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa slob ma gzhug pa'i bya ba ni/ slob ma tshad ldan yin na dbang rdzogs par bskur/ dam tshig bsrung du bcug nas lam la rim pa bzhin du slob du gzhug go /gshin don byed na lho sgo'i cho ga dbang bskur dang bcas pa bya'o// de ltar thams cad grub pa na/ bdag nyid la dbang bskur ba sogs dang*/ mdun gyi lha la mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes su dngos grub blang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas rdul tshon gyi lha rnams/

oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang*/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ gsum dang*/ badz+ra muḥlha rnams kyi phyag rgya bkrol la gshegs su gsol/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig cing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs brjod la/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don dran par bya/ lha'i gdan la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams bsdu zhing*/ rdul tshon mtha' nas dbus su phyags la/ bum pa'am za ma tog tu blugs/ thig rjes rnams dri bzangs kyi chus mi mngon par byas la/ bkra shis bya'o// gal te sgrub mchod zhag mang po byed na/ gshegs gsol gyi tshab tu brtan bzhugs byed de/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes sogs brjod/ nub tha mal sngar ltar gshegs gsol bya'o// 'di ni gzhan phan mtha' yas la// zur 'debs tshul du legs sbyar bas// rdul tshon dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim// tshang la ma nor shes par 'gyur// kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la nye bar mkho ba 'di ni gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer gyi dgongs pa ltar/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sde snod 'dzin pa bsam 'grub bzang pos bgyis pa'o// // ༄༅// rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la nye bar mkho ba'i cha gsum gtor ma bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi cho ga byed pa'i skabs su gtor ma cha gsum mdor bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma gsum bshams pa'i dang po phyogs skyong bcu la dbul te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas ma dag pa bsang zhing*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/

oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gzi byin bskyed la rin po che'i snod yangs pa bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsams nas/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul du byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan// snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che// lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu// rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs su 'tshal// bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ gyis gdan phul la/ oṃ in+d+rā ya/ ag+na ya/ ya mā ya/ nair ṛ t+yā ya/ wa ru ṇā ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī shwa rā ya/ ud+dhaṃ brah+mā ya/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ adh+wa pṛ thi wi bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ n+ya ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas pas dam la bzhag de nas sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes la/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/shar lho'i gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs// nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sngar gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul nas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa stengs klu// ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la// swaḥswaḥso sor gtor ma 'bul ba ni// rab tu dges pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su// rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pas phrin las bcol la/

chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med par// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ sngar gyi da sha dika sogs kyi rjes la gats+tsa btags pas gshegs su gsol lo// gnyis pa 'byung po rnams la 'bul te/ snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis lha thams cad spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la// bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig

/oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dhar+bha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho rā ga ma nuṣ+ya/ a ma nuṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gri h+ṇe daṃ ba l+ya di swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu bsil ma can na gang gnas dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*// khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*// gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*// lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams// rab tu dges shing mgu bar gyur nas su// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag sol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pas phrin las bcol zhing*/ snga ma ltar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo// gsum pa bgegs rnams la sbyin te/

rang nyid rigs kyi khro bo gang yin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcings la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yung tsam nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dza/ zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams gtor ma len pa'i phyir du 'ongs par bsams la/ oṃ gung ka re gung ka re swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sarba bigh+nā na grih+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis mchod la/ gong gi sngags gsum gyi rjes su/ sarba bi gh+nā na na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo zhes sogs btags la lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin pas tshim par bsams la/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yis// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// zhes bsngos la/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// 'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du// rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa// nad de nye bar phyung nas su// gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis// mchod dang bsnyen bkur
